my three favorite rituals with my health app 🤍

#fitnessapp #soma #wellness

slides.text:
3 things I love doing
with SOMA

1 — Checking my morning
readiness

It reads my night and picks
how hard today should be

2 — Scanning my gym

One photo — and the program
uses what's actually there

3 — Eating without
macro math

It watches my nutrition
so I don't have to

slides.heading: One app, whole body
slides.body: SOMA connects your wearables and builds each day around your sleep, training and meals
